correctness.rationale: The homogeneous ideal normal form and characteristic-polynomial criterion are verified against Homma--Kim. Irreducibility over F2 is exactly det(A)=det(A+I)=1. There are two cubic classes of 24 matrices, paired by I, yielding 24 quartics. Eight Sylow-7 subgroups each give a 3-member pencil; three explicit disjoint H-orbits of size 7 exhaust all 21 outsider curves and have determinant obstructions, proving exclusivity. GL3(2) normalizer sizes give orbit/stabilizer claims. Exact 512-matrix enumeration and separate 255-form Groebner tests both pass from packaged paths, with 3 affine charts and complete finite domains. No independence or proof for larger fields is asserted.
